requirements.text: Personalised timetable management allowing students to colour-code modules, hide cancelled classes, and add personal study blocks with a drag-and-drop interface, along with the option to export or sync to external calendars.

A notification settings section where students can choose how they receive alerts (email, SMS, in-app), with options for immediate or daily summary notifications for grades, and customizable reminders for assignment deadlines at various intervals.
The ability for students to set 'quiet hours' to manage the frequency and timing of notifications.
A structured online feedback system collected after the teaching period, focusing on content quality, delivery methods, and resources, using a mix of rating scales and open-ended questions.
Anonymised feedback that is aggregated and shared with module coordinators to foster continuous improvement while ensuring student responses remain confidential.
Ensure all enhancements align with existing systems and policies, including compliance with GDPR and data retention policies.
